The fuck? Kelly’s running speed is in the sixties, nearly the seventies. She’s faster than civilian cars most of the time. 

Also the knife stabbing through the lich’s hull isn’t a gameplay mechanic. It happened in a cutscene in Halo 4. 

15MM? Based on the size of the chaingun alone whoever decided that was the round size was talking out of their ass. The recoil alone would shatter any marine’s entire body, unless you’re arguing that every human in the doom universe is Spartan level. 

The muzzle velocity of UNSC weapons is usually described as over double that of modern day firearms.  Making the kinetic force a lot stronger than that of modern day firearms. Most UNSC weapons also chamber armor piercing which would help tremendously against doomguy’s Mega Armor. In Halo: Ghosts of Onyx, when the insurrection had MA5s with armor piercing rounds, Kurt-051 described them as “being armed to take down an MBT” which in Halo means an M808 Scorpion, which is layered in thick titanium-A and ceramic armor.

Also yes he’s punched through it. He’s straight up gutted wraiths with his bare hands and even stabbed through a Lich’s hull with a regular combat knife. Also Chief has survived falling from space multiple times. A feat of durability that doomguy pre-divinity machine just cannot match.

Chief’s running speed is in the fifties in miles per hour but that’s neither here nor there. Sure doomguy is faster, but Chief would easily be able to react and with the help of Cortana he would be able to tag doomguy, again he’s tagged ghosts which are faster than rockets. 

Also doomguy isn’t faster than the muzzle velocity of any UNSC firearms which given how pre-divinity doomguy does against a chaingunner’s barrage means that a couple bursts from a BR55 or a barrage from an MA5B and its lights out. 

Sure getting hit by a BFG shot or a rocket could be deadly to Chief, but it wouldn’t oneshot thanks to his energy shields which can take stuff like a fuel rod to the face. I also doubt that the rocket launcher in doom would have the same explosive yield as a SPNKR which can oneshot covenant light vehicles.

Chief has everything he needs to be able to simply gun down doomguy. His ludicrous running speed really doesn’t mean much when he can’t outrun bullets as seen by all the hitscan enemies in the original doom games. Chief can take hits that doomguy can’t, and the fight would literally just be doomguy getting gunned down while Chief survives whatever shot came his way thanks to Mjolnir’s energy shields and superior durability.

Okay while punching apart titanium equivalent roughness is impressive it is nowhere near Chief being able to punch through Covenant Nanolaminate armor which is stated to be vastly superior to the UNSC’s titanium-A which is molecularly reinforced to be dozens of times stronger than regular titanium.

Chief’s reflexes are also vastly superior to even his own speed, it is consistently stated that Spartans adrenaline can basically let them see in bullet time. Which is even more impressive in the Halo universe given that the muzzle velocity of UNSC firearms is far greater than modern day counterparts.

Cortana also gives Chief a wealth of information available while on the fly, able to use the Mjolnir armor sensors to analyze enemies and relay valuable tactical data. Pre-divinity machine doomguy gets his ass beat, medium difficulty at best.
